definitions.adx.trend.started.bearish: ADX rose to the trend level (25 by default) with -DI above +DI: a trend is under way, downward.
definitions.atr.regime.expansion: ATR as a percent of close rose into the upper band of its recent range (percentile crossed up through the expansion threshold).
definitions.atr.regime.contraction: ATR as a percent of close fell into the lower band of its recent range (percentile crossed down through the contraction threshold).
definitions.bollinger.break.belowLower: Source price crossed from inside/at the band to below the lower band.
definitions.bollinger.squeeze.released: After a squeeze, band width rose back to the middle of its recent range (default: 50th percentile): volatility is expanding again.
definitions.bollinger.reentry.fromBelow: After a close below the lower band, price closed back inside or at it.
definitions.dss.cross.bullish: The DSS line crossed above its trigger line.
definitions.dss.cross.bearish: The DSS line crossed below its trigger line.
definitions.dss.level.oversold: The DSS line moved below the oversold level (default 20).
definitions.dss.exit.oversold: The DSS line rose back above the oversold level (default 20): downward momentum is fading.
definitions.ema.cross.above: Source price moved from at/below the EMA to above it.
definitions.ema.cross.below: Source price moved from at/above the EMA to below it.
definitions.rsi.midline.bullish: RSI closed at or above the midline (50 by default) after being below it.
definitions.rsi.midline.bearish: RSI closed below the midline (50 by default) after being at or above it.
definitions.sma.cross.above: Source price moved from at/below the SMA to above it.
definitions.sma.cross.below: Source price moved from at/above the SMA to below it.
definitions.sma.lost: Price, settled above the SMA, closed below it by at least the ATR buffer on enough consecutive bars (default 2 closes, half an ATR).
definitions.swing_high_formed: A swing high was confirmed. The event falls on the confirming bar, a few bars after the high itself.
definitions.lower_high: A new swing high below the previous one was confirmed. The event falls on the confirming bar, a few bars after the high itself.
definitions.swing_low_break: Price broke below a prior swing low.
definitions.swing_low_sweep: Price swept below a prior swing low and quickly reclaimed above it.
definitions.trendline_breach_bullish: Price wicked through a resistance trendline.
definitions.trendline_break_bullish: The candle closed above a resistance trendline.
definitions.smc.orderBlock.formed: A new order block zone was confirmed: the move off its swing closed beyond the last opposing swing (a structure break). The event falls on the confirming bar, after the block candle itself.
definitions.smc.orderBlock.tested: Price returned to test an active order block zone (first touch after departing the zone).
definitions.smc.orderBlock.retested: Price returned to tap a still-live (un-mitigated) order block again — a second or later touch. Payload carries touchCount (2, 3, …).
definitions.smc.orderBlock.mitigated: Price passed through an order block, invalidating it.
definitions.smc.orderBlock.breaker: A mitigated order block was reclaimed and now acts as opposite zone.
definitions.smc.fvg.formed: A price imbalance gap was created by a strong impulse move.
definitions.smc.fvg.tested: Price moved into an unfilled fair value gap for the first time.
definitions.smc.fvg.retested: Price exited and then re-entered a still-unfilled fair value gap — a second or later touch. Payload carries touchCount (2, 3, …).
definitions.smc.fvg.partialFill: Price wicked at least halfway (the mitigation threshold) into a fair value gap.
definitions.smc.fvg.filled: Price closed through the far edge of a fair value gap, filling it. A wick through that closes back inside is a test, not a fill.
definitions.smc.choch.bearish: Price broke below a swing low in an uptrend.
definitions.smc.liquidity.bsl: Equal highs formed a liquidity pool above price: resting stops sit above those highs. The event falls on the bar on which the high that made the pool was confirmed.
definitions.smc.range.discount: Price closed in the lower (discount) half of the dealing range.
definitions.smc.range.equilibrium: Price closed into the equilibrium band around the 50% of the dealing range, from premium or discount — fair value, no edge.
definitions.keyLevel.approached: Price closed near the level, from above a support or below a resistance.
definitions.keyLevel.rejected: Price left the level, staying above a support or below a resistance: the level held.
definitions.keyLevel.broken: Price closed beyond the level by the break buffer.
definitions.keyLevel.retested: Price returned to a broken level from the other side.
definitions.keyLevel.flipped: A broken level held from the other side: its role reversed.
definitions.cycleFib.levels.formed: A cycle leg completed: both of its pivots are confirmed, so its fib levels now exist.
definitions.cycleFib.retrace.reached.382: Price pulled back to the 38.2% retracement of the current cycle leg.
definitions.cycleFib.retrace.reached.500: Price pulled back to the 50% retracement of the current cycle leg.
definitions.cycleFib.retrace.reached.618: Price pulled back to the 61.8% retracement of the current cycle leg.
definitions.cycleFib.retrace.reached.786: Price pulled back to the 78.6% retracement of the current cycle leg.
definitions.cycleFib.golden_pocket.entered: Price pulled back into the 61.8%–65% retracement zone of the current cycle leg.
definitions.cycleFib.level.held: In an upward cycle leg, price touched a retracement level and closed back above it: the level held as support.
definitions.cycle.high.confirmed: The active cycle high pivot met confirmation criteria on the detection timeframe.
definitions.cycle.high.lower_high: The latest confirmed cycle high is lower than the previous confirmed cycle high.
definitions.cycle.low.failed: A provisional or developing cycle pivot low was invalidated as price broke below it.
definitions.cycle.low.window.early: Time since the last confirmed cycle low crossed the 25th percentile of this symbol's inter-cycle gaps — the window OPENS. Weekly and daily: the stored window's opening edge (the same edge the chart draws); hourly: the live state's gap buffer.
definitions.onchain.supply_in_profit.capitulation.en: The share of supply whose creation price is below the close fell below 50%, from at or above 50% the day before: most coins are held below their creation price.
definitions.onchain.supply_in_profit.capitulation.ex: The share of supply whose creation price is below the close closed back at or above 50%, from below 50% the day before.
definitions.onchain.sth_sopr.lose: 7-day short-term-holder SOPR (value spent ÷ value at creation, outputs younger than 150 days, over a week) crossed from at or above 1 to below 1: in aggregate, short-term holders' spent coins moved below their creation value.
definitions.onchain.sth_realised_price.cross.below: The symbol's daily close crossed below the STH realised price (the cost basis of outputs younger than 150 days): on the day before it was at or above it, on this day below it. Compared against the symbol's own stored daily close, decided by the on-chain validator from that close and the level on this day and the day before.
definitions.onchain.cohort.utxo_1k.supply_30d.fall: The supply held by outputs (UTXOs) of at least 1,000 BTC: its 30-day change crossed below its trailing-365-day 5th percentile (days strictly before this one). An output (UTXO) cohort, not entities: one owner can hold many outputs, and consolidating or splitting them moves it with no change of owner.
